svg.title: The A/B Test on One Page
svg.desc: A flow from left to right. Consent and privacy: a form and a shield protect a pool of student silhouettes. Random assignment: the pool is shuffled into two groups by tokens. Two mirror-image lanes. Top lane, the control group, uses the original version, v1, rubric total 65, Revise. Bottom lane, the treatment group, uses the improved version, v1.1, total 78, Adopt. Both lanes take the same pre-test before and the same post-test after. At the right, two gain bars are compared. A hypothesis lightbulb sits at the top. A time strip of four weeks runs along the bottom: week 1 pre-test and assignment, weeks 2 and 3 use the assigned version, week 4 post-test and survey.
